mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.5% in a 3-month window, it signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in nonfarm payrolls indicate a tightening labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During sustained housing market expansion (HOUST > 1000 thousand units), consumer spending and business investment increase, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate consistently indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 in a 3-month window, it signals a contraction in manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicate a delayed monetary response to inflation, increasing equity risk premiums and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production volatility (standard deviation of INDPRO > 5% over 6 months), supply chain disruptions cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO volatility > 5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
